title: [bug] tunnel_auth revocation test fails deterministically: Err(Revoked) vs Err(Replay)
description: Found during lynw fix work. lichen-gateway/src/tunnel_auth.rs:954: test revocation_root_change_expiry_and_lru_fail_closed panics with assertion left: Err(Revoked), right: Err(Replay). Fails deterministically (3/3 runs in isolation, 0.03s) AND on clean HEAD without the lynw changes (verified via git stash round-trip), so it is pre-existing and unrelated to the gateway sender-store fix. The test expects a message to be classified as Revoked but the code returns Replay - likely an ordering issue between revocation check and replay-window check, or the revocation root change / LRU eviction path not refreshing state as the test expects. Fix the code or the test per the intended classification semantics; do not weaken the assertion without understanding which behavior is correct per the spec.
close_reason: Already fixed at HEAD by dafc3ed1a4 (test expectation Replay->Revoked aligning with the code's retained revoked-floor classification); the bead predated this checkout having that commit. Verified on heft: (a) path-included harness over the real tunnel_auth.rs bytes - 5/5 unit tests incl. revocation_root_change_expiry_and_lru_fail_closed + 3/3 canonical vector tests vs test/vectors/tunnel_authorization.json; (b) Python parity legs: generator --check OK (after chmod g-w test/vectors - Ubuntu group-write bit tripped atomic_json safety check, masking as out-of-date; file proven sha-identical to regeneration), pytest vectors 5/5; (c) C parity leg 1/1 (clang; gcc-13 lacks -std=c23). Semantics double-checked: Python tunnel_auth.py:481-483 classifies stale/equal-seq post against revoked floor as REVOKED, matching Rust; both map Replay/Revoked to the same 0x83 denial (classification is diagnostic only, no accept path distinguishes). 3x codereview (correctness/security/robustness, reviewer-model passes): no P0 on the closing change; 4 pre-existing findings filed as new beads (rollback-wipes-floors P1, floor-eviction-vs-CAPACITY P1/P2, selection+last_now P3 pair, heft rust-oscore fork blocker P2 human). Full-crate cargo test -p lichen-gateway remains blocked on heft by the oscore fork gap (see filed blocker bead).
